Cassette 1.7.5 introduces a Windows installer with optional Start menu and desktop shortcuts. It installs for the current user and adds an uninstall entry to Windows Settings. Existing Cassette library data stays in its current location.

- Local files and Offline music are available from the avatar menu.
- The sidebar keyboard shortcut now plays the same open and close animation as the toolbar button and respects reduced-motion settings.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/ctrlcat0x/Cassette/compare/v1.7.0...v1.7.5)
